extracted.name: Grilled Green Beans
extracted.description: Fresh green beans cook up perfectly on the grill for a simple grilled side dish and an easy way to use those garden fresh beans in the summer.
instruction_lines: Combine green beans, olive oil, garlic, and salt in a bowl; toss to coat. Allow green beans to marinate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Arrange green beans on a grill pan.
Place the grill pan on the preheated grill; cook and stir green beans until lightly charred and cooked to desired doneness, about 10 minutes.
